title: 第64章 赵瞎子大出血
content_zh:
第64章 赵瞎子大出血-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

上一章

存书签

“我觉得青山说的也有道理，赵瞎子这种人要是不送到政府去教养，以后说不定就要拿刀子攮咱们了。”

“我家和他家就是邻居，这要是哪天发了神经，来我们家怎么办？”

“娘的，他一人吃饱全家不饿，无牵无挂的，这要是咱们村子谁敢得罪了他，还真是不好说。”

“对，得送去政府教养教养，免得以后伤人。”

周围村民在经过李青山潜意识的提醒后，纷纷意识到赵瞎子的特殊性。

这个家伙，单身汉一个。

今天竟然敢拿着刀子攮人，以后还得了？

就像村子里养了一只恶狼一般，谁敢确定，这恶狼以后不是扑到自己身上来？

要是把这恶狼打死了，大家就没了这隐患。

干不干？

当然干，反正死的又不是自己，说不得最后还能吃一口狼肉呢，要是赵瞎子死在大狱里面还好呢，那房子不也是可以动一动歪心思吗？

“李青山，我又没攮到你，凭什么把我送到大狱里面去？”

“你还真当我赵瞎子是被吓大的？”

赵瞎子冷哼一声，脸上流露出一抹不屑道：“有本事你就去找公安，我看公安能把我怎么样，政府能把我怎么样。”

“能怎么样？”

“能把你关起来。”

就在这时。

一道威严的声音突然在众人身后响起，石溪村的百姓转身望去，正是乡里面的一名年轻公安，大概二十七八岁的样子，五官棱角坚毅，看身姿估计是从军队上面退下来的。

身上穿着55式警服，这一款警服式55年开始服役，等到明年就会有新的58式警服出来，和后世的警服不太一样，上衣式白色的，和白色的衬衫相似，但更加规整一些，直接理解成类似于白色衬衫即可。

白色上衣，清清白白的为人民服务。

至于裤子则是藏青色的，55式的警服领口没有领章，等到58式的警服，领口就有了领章，55式警服主要是在胸口的位置有标识，比如说单位什么的。

头上戴着白色的大檐帽，大檐帽还有一圈红色的线！

最中间还有国徽，麦穗，齿轮在一起相互融合，组合的图案！

这公安一看就是步行来的，毕竟现在还是57年，一直到70年初期，工业发展起来后，才会配备自行车，等到75年的时候，就开始配备摩托车了，等到80年代的时候，就会配备一些面包车之类的。

现在的公安都是双腿走路，辖区又广，又没什么摄像头，抓捕和办案十分困难。

但是，在老百姓心中的威严还是极重的。

“呦，周公安，您怎么来了？”村支书明显是认识这位周公安的，连忙走上前去奉承道：“来，您抽烟！”

"I think what Qingshan said makes sense. If people like Blind Zhao are not sent to the government for reeducation, they might be able to stab us with knives in the future."

"My family and his family are neighbors. What if one day you get crazy and come to our house?"

"Mom, he has enough food for himself and the whole family is not hungry. He has no worries. If anyone in our village dares to offend him, it's really hard to say."

"Yes, you need to send him to a government correctional facility to prevent him from hurting others in the future."

After Li Qingshan's subconscious reminder, the surrounding villagers realized the special nature of Zhao Xiazi.

This guy is a bachelor.

You dared to stab someone with a knife today, will you do it again in the future?

It's like a bad wolf has been raised in the village. Who can be sure that this bad wolf won't pounce on him in the future?

If this evil wolf is killed, everyone will no longer have this hidden danger.

Do it or not?

Of course, it’s not me who died anyway, so I don’t know if I’ll be able to eat a bite of wolf meat in the end. It would be better if Blind Zhao died in prison, then wouldn’t the house be a place where he could have his own evil thoughts?

"Li Qingshan, I didn't capture you, why should you send me to prison?"

"Do you really think that Blind Zhao, I, was frightened?"

Blind Zhao snorted coldly and said with a hint of disdain on his face: "If you have the ability, go to the police. I'll see what the public security can do to me and what the government can do to me."

"What can we do?"

"I can lock you up."

Just then.

A majestic voice suddenly sounded behind everyone. The people of Shixi Village turned around and saw that it was a young police officer from the village. He was about 27 or 28 years old. His features were angular and firm. Judging from his appearance, he must have retired from the army.

He is wearing a Type 55 police uniform. This type of police uniform has been in service since 1955. The new Type 58 police uniform will be released next year. It is different from the police uniforms of later generations. The top is white, similar to a white shirt, but more regular. It can be directly understood as similar to a white shirt.

Wear a white shirt and serve the people innocently.

As for the pants, they are navy blue. The Type 55 police uniform does not have a collar badge on the collar. When the Type 58 police uniform comes, it will have a collar badge. The Type 55 police uniform mainly has logos on the chest, such as the unit.

Wearing a white big-brimmed hat on his head, the big-brimmed hat also has a circle of red thread!

In the middle there is the national emblem, ears of wheat, and gears that blend together to create a combined pattern!

It seems that the police are here on foot. After all, it is still 1957. It was not until the early 1970s, when the industry developed, that they would be equipped with bicycles. In 1975, they began to be equipped with motorcycles. In the 1980s, they would be equipped with some vans and the like.

Today's police officers only walk on two legs, their jurisdiction is very wide, and there are few cameras, so it is very difficult to arrest and handle cases.

However, the majesty in the hearts of ordinary people is still very heavy.

"Hey, Public Security Zhou, why are you here?" The village party secretary obviously knew this Public Security Zhou, and he quickly stepped forward and flattered him: "Come on, you smoke!"
